220.5.10.1(8).explanation: A building with a passenger terminal, hospital or similar loading-intensive use must provide loading spaces by Type according to gross floor area, from none under 500 square metres up to 5 Type B for 22000 to under 30000 square metres.

220.5.10.1(9).explanation: In Policy Area 1 or 2, a building with two or more of office, retail store, eating establishment, personal service shop or hotel uses adds up its loading spaces: the largest Type B (and the largest Type C) requirement of any one of those uses, plus the spaces for its other non-residential uses.
